main.description: A named set of references: a manuscript in progress, a reading list, a syllabus, a systematic review screening set. Membership is NOT stored here -- it lives in pub.paper.collectionItem. Embedding an item array would hit the 1MB record ceiling on any real bibliography and would force a full rewrite on every add.

purpose.description: Drives client affordances: a 'writing' collection shows citekeys and a .bib export button; a 'reading' collection shows status and priority.

targetVenue.description: Journal or conference being targeted. Lets a client pick the CSL style and journal-abbreviation policy automatically.

manuscript.description: Optional AT-URI of the document this bibliography belongs to.

repository.description: Optional link to the manuscript's source repository (Tangled, GitHub, ...).

collaborators.description: DIDs of co-authors on this collection. Advisory only: atproto has no cross-repo write, so each collaborator maintains their own records and an AppView merges them into a shared view.
